summary: Iter49 verified end-to-end. Backend 6/6 pytest pass: POST /briefs returns real Gemini-2.5-flash second-LLM validation block (verdict/confidence/notes/validator_provider/validator_model, persists in Mongo, ~50s latency including Claude draft + Gemini verify); /ask response shape unchanged with active plays present in context; /strategic-goals still sorted by _target_date_sort_key (now lifted to module scope); sandbox /sample-doc + /accept regression intact. Frontend (live preview): Activity mark-as-read flips testid from activity-item-{id} to activity-item-{id}-read after click+navigate-back, unread dot disappears; Mark-all-read button (data-testid=activity-mark-all-read) marks every visible item read and survives reload (localStorage 'akki.activity.read.{cid}'); Workspace doc-play-context panel renders 'Workflow context · 2 active' with two doc-play-link-{id} entries (board_pack + pre_board); ValidatedBadge chip renders 'Validated by an independent model' and validated-badge-popover testid resolves on hover with the validator-pass explanation copy.

issues: Clicking the past-brief row in the right rail did not open a role=dialog modal in our scripted run (selector clicked the inner text node 'Underwriting margin' but no modal mounted). Badge + popover were verifiable in-place on the Generate panel; suggest exposing data-testid='prepare-brief-history-{id}' on the row root so testing agents can target the click target reliably (current selector matches multiple inner divs).

action_items: Optional: ensure data-testid='prepare-brief-history-{id}' is on the clickable row root in Prepare.jsx so the BriefDetailModal can be opened deterministically by tests (the row currently nests text divs that intercept the click without bubbling to the openable handler).

validate_independent latency was ~50s on first call (Claude draft + Gemini verify combined). Soft-fail closed contract works, but consider issuing the Gemini call concurrently (asyncio.gather) with audit-log writes to keep p50 under 30s once warm.
critical_code_review_comments: llm_service.validate_independent uses asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=12) but emergentintegrations may itself buffer past that — confirm the wrapper raises TimeoutError on timeout (currently caught generically).
prepare.create_brief stores `validated: True` AND a `validation` dict — the boolean is now redundant; consider deprecating in favour of validation.verdict to avoid drift.
signals_ask.ask: plays_block stage_label maps current_stage by index without bounds-check — if a play has stage>=len(stages_for_type), it falls into the f-string fallback. Fine but worth a comment.

Activity.jsx Mark-all-read works correctly — confirmed localStorage key 'akki.activity.read.{cid}' is keyed per-context, which is the right scope. Read state survived reload + reload-with-different-cat-pill in our run.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all iter49 features verified; only modal-open click-target needs a stable testid)

seed_data_creation: Created one Tuli-CFO brief (kind=topic, objective='Brief me on the audit committee\'s top three risks heading into Q2 2026') via backend test — visible in Prepare past-briefs rail. Created a sandbox session via /api/sandbox/generate (company_name=TEST_Iter49Co) for sample-doc regression — auto-expires.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter49 ships clean. Backend brief endpoint POST /api/contexts/{cid}/briefs now returns and persists `validation: {verdict, confidence, notes[], validator_provider, validator_model}` (provider=gemini, model=gemini-2.5-flash on happy path; soft-fails to {qualified, 60, ['Validator unavailable…']} on outage). Ask endpoint prepends [ACTIVE WORKFLOWS] block to prompt when up to 3 active plays exist; response shape unchanged. strategic_goals._target_date_sort_key is now a module-level function. Frontend testids: activity-item-{id}, activity-item-{id}-read, activity-item-{id}-unread-dot, activity-mark-all-read, validated-badge, validated-badge-popover, doc-play-context, doc-play-link-{id}. ValidatedBadge popover triggers on hover (mouseenter), not click.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs surfaced this iteration. One minor selector-stability suggestion logged for the past-brief row click target.
